name: Laer Gjoll: Horror at Cemetery
storyline: The story follows a traveling archaeologist who sets out to find a very valuable magical artifact. The nature of the artifact was unknown. All that was known was that it could be used to prevent the consequences of a global cataclysm. The hero travels throughout the kingdom, and then his search leads him to a very strange and ancient cemetery...
summary:
Laer Gjoll is a russian total conversion mod to Gothic II created by FaWl MT (Feuermagier and Wallerstein Lab). The mod's core is a fantasy narrative with an emphasis on horror and dark atmosphere.
The story follows a traveling archaeologist who sets out to find a very valuable magical artifact. The nature of the artifact was unknown. All that was known was that it could be used to prevent the consequences of a global cataclysm. The hero travels throughout the kingdom, and then his search leads him to a very strange and ancient cemetery...
Features
- separate story, completely unrelated to the plot of the original Gothic 2
- new locations, environmental textures, weapons, armor types and many re-designs
- 90% of music replacement
- professional russian and polish voiceover
